items.text: Before the break: Any Doubts? — and last week, The Return read what the break did with our practices
The practice carried across: the Personal Doubts Inventory
“Anyone want to say one sentence about how that landed — the inventory, or anything that surfaced, or that you didn’t get to it?”
One sentence each, voluntary — received without commentary
The works were prepared — beforehand, not by us, not for us to invent. Our job is to walk in them
UPHILL mission — what I do: a goal, a plan, measurable steps. Good and real — and the smaller half
DOWNHILL mission — what I am: the effect I have on the people around me when I am most aligned with the Spirit and most genuinely myself. It flows; you don’t have to push it
The test: “When I am at my most genuinely myself — not performing, not managing, just present and open — what do the people around me get to be?”
Eleven weeks of uphill clearing behind us — tonight we ask the downhill question

panel.label: EPHESIANS 2:10
lines: “For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them.”

slides.title: Bridge to the Split — Two Exercises

items.text: Gifts and Passions (H13.1) — about twenty minutes: ten alone, ten sharing. Where are you alive? What comes naturally? Where do others tell you you have something to offer?
Downhill Mission (H13.2) — about twenty minutes: five alone, then name your answer to the cluster. “When I am at my best, what the room gets is ___.”
In each round a parent goes first — teens choose their own depth, and passing holds
The cluster may add what they have noticed — a parent may speak to a teen’s gifts, and a teen to a parent’s

slides.title: Gifts and Downhill in Family Clusters

items.text: Phase 1 — Gifts and Passions: quiet writing (10 min), then 60 seconds each: “The three things I noticed are ___. The one I’m most surprised by is ___.”
After each share the cluster affirms what it has seen — specific and brief: “Yes — we see that in you. Specifically: ___.”
Phase 2 — Downhill Mission: five quiet minutes, then around the circle, 90 seconds each
“What I noticed is that when I’m at my best, what the room gets is ___.”
One or two voices add what they have actually seen across Getting Started — especially each other’s family
The naming is the gift — no over-processing. Pass-anytime holds
What was named in your cluster stays in your cluster — nobody repeats their downhill answer
One sentence from each Cluster Companion — one general thing they noticed, not a specific person
Then one observation across the room
“The downhill mission you named is not a final answer. It is the working draft you are walking in this season.” It will deepen. It will sharpen

slides.title: Practice This Week — and the Road Ahead

items.text: One small action this week, aligned with your downhill answer. One. Not a campaign. Specific — then journal what happens (H13.3)
If your downhill is “the room gets calmer” — sit with a friend in distress this week instead of trying to fix them
Ahead: the Rhythm week — we build the practices you will carry when the Wednesdays stop
Week 21 — the family commissioning: bring your whole family, even members who have not been here. We start at 6:30, light food at 6:00
Week 22 — the commissioning of our Companions-in-Formation. Their night; come to witness it
